title: Show and Describe: Image Captioning with Vision-Language Models
abstract: We present a model for image captioning that generates natural language descriptions of photographs. Our vision-language model combines a visual encoder with a text decoder to produce fluent captions. Experiments show strong results on standard image captioning benchmarks.

title: Neural Machine Translation with Attention Mechanisms
abstract: This paper studies neural machine translation between languages using an encoder-decoder architecture with attention. We translate text across several language pairs and report improvements in translation quality over prior baselines.

title: End-to-End Speech Recognition for Spoken Language
abstract: We build an end-to-end speech recognition system that converts spoken audio into written text. The acoustic model is trained directly on transcribed speech and improves word error rate on conversational benchmarks.

title: Collaborative Filtering for Movie Recommendation Systems
abstract: We propose a recommendation system based on collaborative filtering that suggests movies to users from their past ratings. The recommendation model learns latent user and item factors and improves ranking of relevant items.

title: Detecting Fake News and Misinformation on Social Media
abstract: We address fake news detection by classifying news articles as reliable or misinformation. Our model uses textual features to flag false claims and helps identify misinformation spreading on social media.

title: Graph Neural Networks for Node Classification
abstract: This work introduces a graph neural network that learns representations of nodes in a graph. By passing messages between neighboring nodes, the graph neural network improves node classification on citation graphs.

title: Deep Reinforcement Learning for Robot Control
abstract: We apply deep reinforcement learning to continuous control of a robot. An agent learns a policy by reinforcement learning from reward signals and achieves stable control in simulated environments.

title: Real-Time Object Detection in Natural Images
abstract: We present a fast object detection model that localizes and recognizes objects in an image. The detector predicts bounding boxes in real time and reaches competitive accuracy on common object detection datasets.

title: Abstractive Text Summarization with Transformers
abstract: We study abstractive text summarization that rewrites a long document into a short summary. Our transformer model generates fluent summaries and improves over extractive summarization baselines.

title: Building an Open-Domain Dialogue System
abstract: We describe a dialogue system, or chatbot, that converses with users on open topics. The dialogue system generates context-aware responses and is evaluated on multi-turn conversations.

title: A Survey of Transformer Architectures for Sequence Modeling
abstract: This survey reviews transformer architectures and self-attention for sequence modeling across many tasks. We summarize design choices, training methods, and applications of transformers.

title: Image Classification with Convolutional Neural Networks
abstract: We train convolutional neural networks for image classification. The model assigns a category label to each image and reaches high accuracy on standard image classification benchmarks.
